claims.exact_statement: For every Boolean F in the frozen six-variable edge-partition family F(y,x)=g(x)+chi_01(y)1_E01(x)+chi_10(y)1_E10(x)+chi_11(y)1_E11(x), where the E_a are three disjoint four-cube edges, g is sign-valued off their union and zero on it, and all four address-conditioned squared spectra are product laws, H(F)/I(F) <= 40/17. Equality occurs in 1,792 of the 1,015,808 enumerated symmetry representatives.
hypotheses: two address bits and four physical bits
three pairwise vertex-disjoint physical cube edges
one nonzero address character per edge
residual ternary slice zero exactly on the edge union
normalized residual squared Walsh law is product
uniform cube and entropy in bits
proof_dependencies: integer Walsh transform and exact product-law identities
claims.refutes: existence of a ratio larger than 40/17 inside the frozen edge-partition domain
claims.first_unproved_line: No inference to arbitrary C022 functions, larger physical dimension, or non-edge conditional cells is proved.
